WITH invoice_means AS (
  SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) AS mean_price
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  WHERE product_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
invoice_counts AS (
  SELECT i.invoice_number, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_count
  FROM Invoices i
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  GROUP BY i.invoice_number
)
SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(mean_price) FROM invoice_means) AS avg_of_invoice_mean_price,
  (SELECT AVG(line_count) FROM invoice_counts) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice;
